en.name: Build and test your first agent
en.teaches: Creating an agent, writing instructions that hold, and using the test pane to see why it answered the way it did.
en.build: A working agent that answers from its instructions alone, and a habit of reading the test pane rather than guessing.

zh.name: 建出并测试你的第一个 agent
zh.teaches: 创建 agent、把说明写得站得住、以及用测试面板看清楚它为什么这么答。
zh.build: 一个只靠说明就能作答的 agent，以及「看测试面板而不是靠猜」的习惯。

en.name: Ground it in your own documents
en.teaches: Adding knowledge sources, checking what was actually retrieved, and making the agent cite rather than assert.
en.build: An agent that answers only from documents you chose, shows its source, and says so when it does not know.

zh.name: 让它依据你自己的文档作答
zh.teaches: 添加知识来源、检查它实际检索到了什么、以及让它给出处而不是张口就来。
zh.build: 一个只依据你选定的文档作答、并给出出处、不知道就说不知道的 agent。

en.name: Pin the paths that must be deterministic
en.teaches: Topics and trigger phrases, and where a scripted path beats letting the model decide.
en.build: One conversation that always goes the same way — the one your compliance people would ask about.

zh.name: 把必须确定的路径钉死
zh.teaches: Topics 与触发短语，以及什么地方「写死的流程」优于「让模型自己决定」。
zh.build: 一段永远走同一条路的对话——就是合规同事一定会问的那一段。

en.name: Let the model choose the tool
en.teaches: Generative orchestration: describing tools well enough that the agent picks the right one, and seeing what it picked.
en.build: An agent with more than one thing it could do, choosing correctly — and a feel for when it will not.

zh.name: 让模型自己选工具
zh.teaches: 生成式编排：把工具描述写到 agent 能选对，并且看得见它选了哪个。
zh.build: 一个有多种可能动作的 agent，能选对——以及对「它什么时候会选错」的手感。

en.name: Reach a real system
en.teaches: Connectors and custom actions: passing parameters in, getting a result back, and handling the call that fails.
en.build: An agent that reads or writes something outside itself, and does not lie when the call errors.

zh.name: 连到一个真实系统
zh.teaches: 连接器与自定义动作：把参数传进去、把结果拿回来、以及调用失败时怎么办。
zh.build: 一个能读写外部系统的 agent，并且在调用出错时不会编。

en.name: Put the deterministic steps in a flow
en.teaches: Calling Power Automate from an agent, and drawing the line between what the model decides and what the flow guarantees.
en.build: A flow the agent calls, doing the part that must happen the same way every time.

zh.name: 把确定性步骤放进流
zh.teaches: 从 agent 调用 Power Automate，以及划清「模型决定什么」和「流保证什么」的界线。
zh.build: 一条被 agent 调用的流，负责那些每次都必须一模一样的步骤。

en.name: Get structured fields out of a document
en.teaches: Reading fields off invoices, forms or contracts, and deciding the confidence line below which a human looks.
en.build: A document in, structured values out, and an exception path for the ones that are not clear enough.

zh.name: 从文档里抽出结构化字段
zh.teaches: 从发票、表单或合同里读取字段，并定出「低于多少置信度就转人看」的那条线。
zh.build: 文档进、结构化值出，外加一条给「看不清楚的那些」走的异常路径。

en.name: Put a person in the loop
en.teaches: Approval gates: what the agent may do alone, what needs confirming, and what the record of that decision looks like.
en.build: A step that waits for a human, with the approval captured where an auditor could find it.

zh.name: 把人放回环里
zh.teaches: 审批闸口：哪些 agent 可以自己做、哪些必须有人确认、以及这个决定留下什么记录。
zh.build: 一个会等人的步骤，且审批记录留在审计的人找得到的地方。

en.name: Give it somewhere to remember
en.teaches: Storing and retrieving structured records in Dataverse, and why a spreadsheet stops working at the second user.
en.build: A table the agent reads and writes, with the permissions that decide who sees which rows.

zh.name: 给它一个能记住东西的地方
zh.teaches: 在 Dataverse 里存取结构化记录，以及为什么表格到第二个用户就撑不住了。
zh.build: 一张 agent 读写的表，以及决定「谁能看到哪几行」的权限设置。

en.name: Publish it where people already are
en.teaches: Publishing to Teams or a website, and the sharing and consent questions that appear the moment you do.
en.build: An agent a colleague can open without being told how — the point at which it stops being yours.

zh.name: 把它发布到人本来就在的地方
zh.teaches: 发布到 Teams 或网站，以及发布那一刻立刻冒出来的共享与授权问题。
zh.build: 一个同事不用教就能打开的 agent——从这一刻起它不再只是你的。

en.name: Keep it inside the guardrails
en.teaches: Environments, DLP policy and roles: where an agent is allowed to live and which connectors it may touch.
en.build: A clear answer to "where does this run, and who decided it could" — before someone from security asks.

zh.name: 让它待在护栏里
zh.teaches: 环境、DLP 策略与角色：agent 允许待在哪、能碰哪些连接器。
zh.build: 对「这东西跑在哪、谁批准的」有个明确答案——赶在安全同事来问之前。

en.name: Find out whether it is working
en.teaches: Session analytics and evaluation: what to measure against the baseline you took before you started.
en.build: A number you would be willing to show at the gate, and the sessions behind it.

zh.name: 搞清楚它到底有没有用
zh.teaches: 会话分析与评估：对着「开工前记录的基线」该看哪些数。
zh.build: 一个你敢拿到闸门上给人看的数字，以及它背后的会话记录。
